definition: to keep your distance and avoid something
description: A gravel path across a university lawn at sunset, with red brick buildings covered in ivy behind. A large goose stands on the path with its wings spread wide and its neck stretched out. A young woman in a maroon sports top and shorts leaps sideways off the path onto the grass, laughing, to keep clear of it, and runs off. A young man on a bicycle rides past the goose, and a young man and woman holding coffee cups stand still and watch from a distance. The goose then folds its wings.

en.question: What is the woman in shorts doing?

de.answer: Sie hält sich von der Gans fern.
de.question: Was macht die Frau in Shorts?

es.answer: Se está manteniendo alejada del ganso.
phrases: pasar en bicicleta junto al ganso
